preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and n * (n - 1) / 2, inclusive.
Each city number vi and ui is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of cities is connected by no more than one road.
preconditions.description: The road network is a simple graph.

preconditions.expression: It is possible to get from any city to any other one along Berland roads.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number.

postconditions.expression: output is the maximum possible value of the average number of safe roads among all shortest paths from the culture capital to the main one.
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum average number of safe roads across all shortest paths.
